# @purista/sandbox-service

> A professional, multi-tenant sandboxing provider built for the PURISTA framework, enabling secure, isolated execution environments for autonomous agents and human users.

## Documentation
- [Architecture Overview](./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Message flow and resource-based dependency injection.
- [Driver Selection Guide](./docs/DRIVERS.md): Comparison of Docker, Lima, Tart, and Firecracker backends.
- [Secure Git Integration](./docs/GIT_AUTH.md): How GitHub CLI auth and Git credential helpers are managed securely.

## AI Agent Skills
If you are an AI agent tasked with working on this repository, you must consult these skills:
- [META-SKILL](./skills/META-SKILL.md): The primary orchestrator and constraints.
- [PURISTA Architect](./skills/PURISTA-Architect.md): Pluggable drivers and self-healing registries.
- [PURISTA Developer](./skills/PURISTA-Developer.md): Command and Subscription implementation blueprints.
- [PURISTA Infrastructure](./skills/PURISTA-Infrastructure.md): Event Bridge and Queues.
- [PURISTA Testing](./skills/PURISTA-Testing.md): Unit testing blueprints.
